thread:
sam_sales: quick heads-up — Pharmaco (pilot) needs access to evaluate Dedicated pool + SSO for a 2-week POC. Security wants least-privileged invites and a clear expiry.

jordan_se: ok — can you send the attendee emails? We can create two scoped roles: `poc_viewer` (metrics/logs) and `poc_infer` (call inference). Recommend ephemeral invites (7–14 days) and separate API tokens bound to the dedicated pool.

mira_security: pharma compliance asks: audit logs retained, KMS-backed keys for any long-lived tokens, and invitation expirations enforced. Also confirm no PHI will be sent during the POC.

tim_platform: we can do ephemeral workspace invites via CLI. Example: 
```
redwood invite --email alice@pharmaco.com --role poc_infer --expires 2026-04-05T12:00:00Z --ephemeral
```
Also we'll bind tokens to pool-id `dp-pharmaco-01` so they can't be used against other tenants.

sam_sales: client prefers 7 days for the initial access window — can we set that?

jordan_se: yes, set `--expires=+7d`. We'll also enable rotate-on-use for those tokens and restrict allowed models to the quantized family to limit cost and surface area.

mira_security: need an escalation/revoke flow if an invite is compromised. Can we revoke all invites and rotate keys quickly? Document the steps.

tim_platform: revoke endpoint exists: `POST /admin/revoke?token=...`. I'll add an automated runbook and a one-click revoke script. ops-bot: created runbook gist <https://internal.gists/redwood/gh/pharmaco-poc-runbook>.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: runbook created by tim_platform

sam_sales: I just shared the attendee emails in DM. One more question — can they use hosted API keys for initial smoke tests before the dedicated pool is provisioned?

jordan_se: allowed for smoke only. Hosted keys must have dataset-isolation flag and very short TTL (1–2 hours). We'll log those calls separately and show the caveats to the customer.

mira_security: explicitly disallow sending PHI over hosted keys; legal to confirm. Also request signed AIA (app usage agreement) for the POC.

sam_sales: noted, I'll collect the signed AIA and confirm PHI policy with the customer.

jordan_se: also adding a scheduled cleanup job to remove guest accounts after 30 days and a nightly audit that flags tokens with `role:poc_*`. Small revoke script below: 
```
#!/bin/bash
redwood tokens list --filter "role:poc_*" --older-than 30d | xargs -r redwood tokens revoke
```

mira_security: that covers most concerns. Add a KMS proof-of-configuration screenshot for the customer if they ask.

tim_platform: provisioning `dp-pharmaco-01` later today, I'll DM sam_sales with pool details and initial admin invite.

sam_sales: thanks all — will update the customer and upload the AIA when I have it. :pray:
